# SerenitySpaces Bahamas

> Private 4-villa corporate event venue in Freeport, Grand Bahama Island. A 35-minute direct flight from Fort Lauderdale (FLL) and under 50 minutes from Miami (MIA). Purpose-built for corporate retreats, executive offsites, team-building events, and client entertainment for US-based (especially Florida-based) companies seeking a Caribbean venue. Rated 4.75 stars from 4 Airbnb reviews. Operating since 2018.

## Key facts

- Location: Sea Breeze area, Freeport, Grand Bahama Island, Bahamas (26.5072°N, -78.64857°W)
- 4 interconnected villas: Agave, Coconut, Lime, Pina
- Main capacity: 14 guests (expandable to ~22 with overflow options)
- Pricing: $650/night entire complex, from $150/night individual villas, $180 cleaning fee, 3-night minimum
- Long-stay discounts: 10% (≤7 nights), 15% (≤14 nights), 20% (≤30 nights), 25% (30+ nights)
- 1/4 mile from Coral Beach, 25 minutes from Grand Bahama International Airport (FPO)
- USD accepted (Bahamian dollar pegged 1:1 to USD); no visa required for US citizens with a valid passport
- Private pool, full chef's kitchen in Lime Villa, high-speed WiFi throughout, dedicated workspaces, self check-in via keypad
